rules: Every stored question state binds its exact question definition and dependency-state digests.
Evidence with an expiry adds expiry_bound even when its role default does not include it.
Governing-instruction changes require confirmation or invalidation for affected non-observational inputs.
An unrelated target edit does not invalidate a state whose declared bindings remain identical.
Accepted decisions are reusable only through a current project-owned decision-reuse record bound to an accepted unsuperseded decision.
Runtime authorization is never collected, persisted, inferred, or reused.

questions.prompt: Which exact target directory is being inspected?

validation_rules: requested mode must equal observed mode
questions.migration_behavior: Recompute on every inspection.
questions.change_consequences: A changed mode requires a new session.

questions.change_consequences: Any instruction change invalidates the session and plan.

validation_rules: a command-line flag cannot confirm authority

questions.prompt: Runtime authorization is intentionally not collected during setup.

recommendation.rationale: Installation, workflow adoption, configuration, and the command itself create no permission.

questions.authoritative_destination: forbidden during setup; runtime work.finish attestation only

limitations: The catalog defines questions and validation semantics; it contains no project answer, identity, endpoint, credential, accepted decision, or standing permission.
Recommendations remain separate from owner selections, and owner selections remain separate from accepted authority.
A completed setup interview establishes neither implementation evidence nor release, production, efficacy, or commercial readiness.
